thread:
Sasha: Heads-up — deploy-bot just blocked the prod promotion for v1.42.0. publish-artifacts job failed during artifact index step.

deploy-bot: Promotion to prod halted: job `publish-artifacts` FAILED (exit 1).
Logs: `ERROR: artifact index mismatch (expected 0x9fa3, got 0x4b2d)`

Raj: ugh. Is this a cache/index corruption or a build variance?

ci-bot: Quick summary: last successful publish-artifacts for that sha was 1769989000. Current run pulled cached index blob, checksum mismatch. Possible remote-cache stale shard.

Maya: Can we fall back to the previously published artifact and promote that? We need to decide before the end of the change window.

Priya (release-manager): Change window ends in 90m. If we can't get a clean publish soon we should pin to the last-green artifact and update release notes + patch changelog.

Ken: Agree on pin if fix is nontrivial. What's the delta between the current artifact and last-green? Any schema/runtime changes requiring DB migrations?

Sasha: No DB migrations in this roll. It's a patch bump (logging + batching). Should be safe to promote last-green.

Raj: Ops question — are we comfortable with skipping the new commit? It means a hotfix will be queued after. I can open a follow-up PR to re-run publish-artifacts after we invalidate the remote cache.

Maya: Steps I propose: 1) Pin deploy manifest to image digest from 1769989000 2) Update release notes with explanation + rollback plan 3) Schedule a maintenance retry for cache cleanup and republish outside change window.

Sasha: Sounds good. Who will own the pin and the release note entry?

Priya (release-manager): I'll own release notes and announce the hold in #general. Raj — can you handle the pin and trigger a manual promote to prod?

Raj: On it. Pinning now to digest: `sha256:3a7f...b2c4` (from 1769989000 run). Will trigger deploybot promote when done.

deploy-bot: manual promote request queued by Raj. Will execute after artifact verification.

ci-bot: Additional action item: run `remote-cache invalidate --prefix artifacts/index/shard-*` and then re-run `publish-artifacts` in staging. I can run that after the change window (17:30 UTC).

Ken: One more ask — add a note in the PR that we attempted republish but hit checksum mismatch; include `--force-reindex` step for the follow-up so we don't re-hit this.

Maya: I'll add the `--force-reindex` flag to the republish job and a short e2e check to validate artifact index before promoting.

Sasha: Thanks team. Priya please post an update in #product-release and tag the schedule for the republish attempt.

Priya (release-manager): Posted and scheduled. Release promoted to prod using pinned digest; release notes updated with "promotion held due to artifact index mismatch; pinned to last-green; follow-up republish scheduled".

Raj: Promote succeeded. Prod health checks passing so far. Closing this thread once follow-up republish completes. :thumbsup:

Sasha: Closing — we'll reopen if the republish encounters issues.
